title: Night shift, 7–8 November
summary: Atrium has been down since Saturday evening and needs a restart (item 1). Otherwise 2 pull requests landed, 1 issue was closed, and nothing was reverted.

landed.text: A word list that fails to upload no longer clears the list you were editing.
Dependency updates, with no change you would notice.

closed.text: Shifts on a public holiday showed twice. Closed, because last week's release already fixed it.

other: Wrote 14 LinkedIn comments and 1 reply, and stopped when LinkedIn paused search on your account at 03:30.

todo.text: Restart Atrium on the production server. Its pages load, but nothing that needs the database works, and its deploys fail until it's back.

held.text: Cancelling an import no longer leaves half of its pages behind.
held.why: It changes code that deletes files, and you asked me to land only low-risk changes.

questions.text: When a household leaves the school, Atrium has to either archive or delete it, and the fix for departed households can't go ahead until that's settled.

options.text: Archive it: the school keeps its cleaning-duty history, but also its personal data until a retention period ends.
Delete it: the personal data goes at once, and so does the history.
